gloss: travel destination; place one is traveling

definitions.gloss: travel destination; place one travels to
definitions.explanation: The place one goes to or is staying at on a trip. The suffix {先|さき} marks the destination or place where an action occurs.

examples.japanese: {旅行先|りょこうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: We decided on a travel destination.

examples.japanese: {旅行先|りょこうさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした。
examples.english: I lost my wallet at my travel destination.

examples.japanese: {旅行先|りょこうさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しか⟦{食|た}べられない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみたい→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: When traveling, I want to enjoy dishes you can only eat in that region.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (travel) + the suffix ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination, place where something happens). The same ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ appears in ⟦{勤|つと}め{先|さき}→勤め先：21550_tsutomesaki⟧ (place of work) and ⟦{連絡|れんらく}{先|さき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧ (contact address).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅行先|りょこうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on a destination
- {旅行先|りょこうさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: while at one's travel destination
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旅行先|りょこうさき}: a popular travel destination

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧: destination — the specific place one is headed; more neutral and precise
- ⟦{行|い}き{先|さき}→行き先：16779_ikisaki⟧: where one is going — broader, used for any outing, not only trips
